items: 【Ergonomic Support】 The ergonomic cross-legged office chair features a thickened crescent-shaped backrest that provides perfect lumbar support, enhancing comfort and promoting a healthier posture.

【Enhanced Cushioning and Footstool】 The ADHD chair for adults features comfortable fabric, 4-inch thick seat cushion, and a 31.5 x 20.5-inch wide footstool, providing excellent support for your hips, feet, knees, and ankles as you change positions.

【360-Degree Swivel & Height Adjustment】 The seat cushion and footstool of the meditation chair rotate 360 degrees, with the seat height adjustable from 0 to 4.7 inches, offering more freedom and boosting focus and creativity.
【Material Options for Everyone】 Choose teddy velvet for its comfort, breathability, and scratch resistance, or opt for PU leather for a luxurious, waterproof, and easy-to-clean finish.
【Smooth Mobility】 The cross legged office chair with 5 durable casters suitable for various floor types, allowing you to easily move around your workspace. Its sturdy design supports up to 385 lbs.

【Easy to Assemble & Support Services】 The criss cross chair with wheels is easy to assemble. Its durable build ensures long-lasting use, and the open design allows for easy access and cleaning. If you encounter a missing parts or a bent bar, please contact us in time, we provide parts replacement or upgrade service.
